asset_target_check.name: asset_target_check
asset_target_check.value:
(
        ("asset"."project_id" is null and "asset"."document_id" is null and "asset"."flashcard_id" is null)
        or ("asset"."project_id" is not null and "asset"."document_id" is not null and "asset"."flashcard_id" is null)
        or ("asset"."project_id" is null and "asset"."document_id" is null and "asset"."flashcard_id" is not null)
      )

quiz_attempt_completion_check.name: quiz_attempt_completion_check
quiz_attempt_completion_check.value: ("quiz_attempt"."status" = 'completed' and "quiz_attempt"."completed_at" is not null and "quiz_attempt"."total_questions" > 0 and "quiz_attempt"."answered_questions" = "quiz_attempt"."total_questions") or ("quiz_attempt"."status" <> 'completed' and "quiz_attempt"."completed_at" is null)
